title: UAE Labour Law: Fired for filing a complaint against your employer? You could get up to 3 months' salary
text:
UAE Labour Law: Fired for filing a complaint against your employer? You could get up to 3 months’ salary
Find out when dismissal is unlawful, how compensation is calculated and why you may still be entitled to gratuity and notice pay
Huda Tabrez
2 min read
Share
Article 47 of the UAE Labour Law – Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 – covers situations where a worker may have been fired because of a labour complaint he or she filed. Picture for illustrative purposes. Picture credit: Pexels
